title: Toronto police shoot, kill man after confrontation in North York park, SIU says
subtitle: The Special Investigations Unit said police were called to a subway station around 11 p.m. for a report of two men fighting. One of the men ran to a nearby park
article: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating after Toronto Police shot and killed a man in Toronto Sunday night.
The Special Investigations Unit said police were called to the Leslie Street subway station around 11 p.m. for a report of two men fighting.
The SIU said one of the men ran away to a nearby park and there was a confrontation involving police during which a police firearm was discharged.
The SIU said a 21-year-old man was hit in the confrontation, and rushed to Sunnybrook where he was pronounced dead. The SIU statement said that he was "fatally shot" by police.
The SIU is an arm's length agency that investigates reports involving police where there's been death, serious injury or allegations of sexual assault.
